passages.text: The king said to me, “Why is your face sad, since you are not sick? This is nothing else but sorrow of heart.” Then I was very much afraid. I said to the king, “Let the king live forever! Why shouldn’t my face be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ tombs, lies waste, and its gates have been consumed with fire?”
passages.note: Grief that shows on the face; sorrow for a ruined home

passages.text: Judah said, “The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading, and there is much rubble; so that we are not able to build the wall.”
passages.note: Exhaustion and burnout; the work feels too much
